logoLicense: From the project site (the logo the MIT repository's README embeds); mark of Earendil Works
oneLine: Minimal terminal coding agent built on a unified LLM API and agent toolkit.
usedFor: Target harness: AGENTS.md rules block, path rules, skills, MCP servers and an in-process extension for the hooks.

name: AGY CLI (Google Antigravity)
logoLicense: From the official site favicon, with its light/dark background disc removed; mono file via Lobe Icons (MIT); Antigravity is a trademark of Google LLC
oneLine: Google's agent-first development platform; AGY CLI is its terminal agent.
usedFor: Target harness: rules, skills, MCP servers, a buracle-companion agent and command hooks read from hooks.json.

name: Context7
logoLicense: From the project repository (MIT); Context7 and Upstash are trademarks of Upstash, Inc.
onDark: glyph visible; the black tile blends in. Use context7-wordmark-dark.svg for a wordmark on dark
oneLine: Upstash service that serves current library documentation to AI agents.
features: Resolves a library name to a Context7 library ID (resolve-library-id)
Returns current docs and code examples for a library ID (query-docs)
Accepts a version in the query to pin docs to a release
Also ships a ctx7 CLI and agent skills that work without MCP
usedFor: MCP server `context7` (@upstash/context7-mcp): up-to-date library and framework docs; routing category library-docs.

name: CodeGraph
logoLicense: From the project repository (MIT; same file as the site favicon); mark of its author
oneLine: Local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that agents query over MCP.
features: One explore call returns the relevant symbols' source and the call paths between them
Callers, callees and impact radius of a symbol before an edit
Full-text symbol search backed by SQLite FTS5
File watcher keeps the index in sync as code changes
Rust parsing kernel covering 20+ languages, fully local
usedFor: MCP server `codegraph` (@colbymchenry/codegraph, `codegraph serve --mcp`): symbols, callers and impact; also the code graph CLI and index builder.

name: Semble
logoLicense: From the project repository (MIT); raster logo downscaled to 320 px and wrapped in SVG (no vector original exists); mark of MinishLab
oneLine: Fast, accurate semantic code search for agents that runs on CPU.
features: Indexes a typical repo in about half a second and answers in milliseconds on CPU
Returns only the relevant chunks, far fewer tokens than grep plus read
Searches local paths, git URLs or several repos together
Finds code similar to a known location (find_related)
No API keys, GPU or external service needed
usedFor: MCP server `semble` (PyPI semble[mcp], installed with uv): semantic code search over local or remote repositories; also the CLI and index builder.

name: Open-WebSearch
logoLicense: No logo: the repository has none and its site (open-web-search.vercel.app) answered HTTP 402
oneLine: Multi-engine web search MCP server, CLI and daemon that needs no API keys.
features: Searches many engines: DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave, Exa, Startpage, Baidu and others
No API keys or sign-in required
Structured results with title, URL and description
Fetches article content (GitHub READMEs, CSDN, Juejin, generic pages as Markdown)
HTTP proxy support and a long-lived local daemon
usedFor: MCP server `web-search` (npm open-websearch): web search without an API key, DuckDuckGo by default; routing category web-search.

name: Fetcher MCP
projectLicense: MIT (GitHub; the npm manifest says ISC)
logoLicense: From the project repository (MIT); mark of its author
oneLine: MCP server that fetches web pages through a headless Playwright browser.
features: Renders JavaScript-heavy pages in headless Chromium via Playwright
Extracts the main content with the Readability algorithm
Returns Markdown, HTML or plain visible text
Fetches many URLs in parallel (fetch_urls)
Blocks images, fonts and media to save bandwidth
usedFor: MCP server `web-fetch` (npm fetcher-mcp): fetch and extract web pages with a headless browser; routing category web-fetch.

name: Grep by Vercel (grep.app MCP)
projectLicense: Proprietary hosted service (Vercel); MCP endpoint https://mcp.grep.app
logoLicense: Mark (rounded frame and cursor) cut from the inline header SVG of grep.app, wordmark left out; no license stated; Grep and Vercel are trademarks of Vercel Inc.
oneLine: Vercel's code search over about a million public GitHub repositories.
features: Searches about a million public GitHub repositories
Literal text or regular-expression queries
Filters by language, repository and file path
Returns ranked code snippets in a fraction of a second
usedFor: Remote HTTP MCP server `grep` (https://mcp.grep.app): real-world usage examples from public GitHub code; routing category code-examples.

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
logoLicense: DevTools icon from the devtools-frontend repository (BSD-3-Clause); Chrome and Chrome DevTools are trademarks of Google LLC
oneLine: Gives coding agents a live Chrome browser through DevTools.
features: Records performance traces and turns them into actionable insights
Inspects network requests and console messages with source-mapped stacks
Takes screenshots and page snapshots
Automates clicks, typing and navigation with Puppeteer and waits for results
usedFor: MCP server `chrome-devtools` (npm chrome-devtools-mcp, isolated profile, no usage statistics): drive and inspect Chrome; every harness except Oh My Pi.

name: CortexDB
logoLicense: From the project repository (MIT; same file as the docs site favicon); mark of its author
oneLine: Local-first agent memory with a knowledge graph in one SQLite file.
features: Stores preferences, decisions and project facts and recalls them before the next prompt
Everything lives in one SQLite file on the local machine
Knowledge graph with ontology constraints, inference and history (SPARQL, Cypher)
Works without an embedding model; one can be added for semantic search
Live web view of the graph, recalls and changes; a gRPC server can share one brain
usedFor: The memory engine: one brain.db with a bucket per project and one for the person, served to every harness by the buracle-memory MCP server.
